full_translation_en:
Federal Parliament
House of Representatives, 2082
Second Session
Meeting Number - 42
Daily Business
Federal Parliament of Nepal
Monday, Shrawan 25, 2083
1:00 PM
Ministry-wise Question and Answer
Regarding oral questions related to the Ministry of Agriculture and the Ministry of Youth, Labor, and Employment, the respective ministers will provide answers.
1.
Management Work
Honorable Finance Minister Dr. Swarnim Wagle:-
2.
(a) To present a proposal seeking leave to introduce the "Employees' Provident Fund (Tenth Amendment) Bill, 2083".
(b) To present the "Employees' Provident Fund (Tenth Amendment) Bill, 2083".
Honorable Minister for Law, Justice, and Parliamentary Affairs Sobita Gautam:-
3.
(a) To present a proposal seeking leave to introduce the "Mediation (Second Amendment) Bill, 2083".
(b) To present the "Mediation (Second Amendment) Bill, 2083".
Honorable Minister for Youth, Labor, and Employment Ramji Yadav:-
4.
(a) To present a proposal seeking leave to introduce the "Child Labor (Prohibition and Regulation) Bill, 2083".
(b) To present the "Child Labor (Prohibition and Regulation) Bill, 2083".
On behalf of the Right Honorable Prime Minister Balendra Shah, Honorable Minister for Law, Justice, and Parliamentary Affairs Sobita Gautam will present a proposal for consideration of the "Constitutional Bodies' Remuneration, Service Conditions, and Facilities (First Amendment) Bill, 2083".
5.
On behalf of the Right Honorable Prime Minister Balendra Shah, Honorable Minister for Law, Justice, and Parliamentary Affairs Sobita Gautam:-
6.
(a) To present a proposal for discussion on the "Bill to Revive the Previous Provisions of the Nepal Special Service Act, 2042, along with the Report of the State Management and Good Governance Committee, 2083".
(b) To present a proposal for the "Bill to Revive the Previous Provisions of the Nepal Special Service Act, 2042" to be passed.
Pan Prasad Poudel
Secretary General
